CREATE TABLE concept AS SELECT i AS concept_id, 'Concept ' || i AS concept_name FROM range(1, 13) t(i);
CREATE TABLE person AS SELECT i AS person_id FROM range(1, 121) t(i);
CREATE TABLE measurement AS
SELECT
  CASE WHEN i % 17 = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST((i * 7) % 10 + 1 AS INTEGER) END AS mc,
  CASE i % 5 WHEN 0 THEN NULL WHEN 1 THEN 11 ELSE CAST((i * 7) % 10 + 1 AS INTEGER) END AS msc,
  CASE WHEN i % 9 = 3 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(((i * 37) % 1000) / 13.0, 2) END AS v,
  CASE i % 6 WHEN 0 THEN NULL WHEN 1 THEN 'low' WHEN 2 THEN 'high' ELSE CAST((i * 7) % 12 AS VARCHAR) END AS vs,
  -- One unit leading each concept: a tie would let either engine pick its own.
  CASE WHEN i % 5 < 3 THEN 'mg' WHEN i % 5 = 3 THEN 'g' ELSE NULL END AS u,
  CAST(CASE WHEN (i * 7) % 10 + 1 = 8 THEN i % 4 + 1 ELSE (i * 13) % 120 + 1 END AS INTEGER) AS person_id,
  TIMESTAMP '2015-01-01 08:00:00' + to_days(CAST((i * 11) % 2000 AS INTEGER)) + to_hours(CAST(i % 24 AS INTEGER)) AS dt
FROM range(1, 6001) t(i)

WITH linkr_event_measurements AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    e."person_id" AS patient_id,
    e."mc" AS concept_id,
    e."dt" AS start_datetime,
    NULL AS visit_id,
    NULL AS visit_detail_id,
    NULL AS concept_terminology,
    NULL AS concept_code,
    e."msc" AS source_concept_id,
    NULL AS concept_name,
    NULL AS end_datetime,
    e."v" AS value_number,
    e."vs" AS value_string,
    e."u" AS unit,
    NULL AS unit_concept_id,
    NULL AS route,
    NULL AS route_concept_id
  FROM (SELECT * FROM "measurement" UNION ALL BY NAME SELECT NULL AS "person_id", NULL AS "mc", NULL AS "dt", NULL AS "msc", NULL AS "v", NULL AS "vs", NULL AS "u" WHERE false) e
)
SELECT named.concept_id AS concept_id,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count
  FROM (SELECT UNNEST(CASE WHEN e.source_concept_id IS DISTINCT FROM e.concept_id THEN [e.concept_id, e.source_concept_id] ELSE [e.concept_id] END) AS concept_id, e.patient_id FROM linkr_event_measurements e) AS named
  WHERE named.concept_id IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(named.concept_id AS BIGINT) IS DISTINCT FROM 0
  GROUP BY 1

-- The statistics of a batch of concepts, in one pass: a row per block of a concept
  WITH linkr_event_measurements AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    e."person_id" AS patient_id,
    e."mc" AS concept_id,
    e."dt" AS start_datetime,
    NULL AS visit_id,
    NULL AS visit_detail_id,
    NULL AS concept_terminology,
    NULL AS concept_code,
    e."msc" AS source_concept_id,
    NULL AS concept_name,
    NULL AS end_datetime,
    e."v" AS value_number,
    e."vs" AS value_string,
    e."u" AS unit,
    NULL AS unit_concept_id,
    NULL AS route,
    NULL AS route_concept_id
  FROM (SELECT * FROM "measurement" UNION ALL BY NAME SELECT NULL AS "person_id", NULL AS "mc", NULL AS "dt", NULL AS "msc", NULL AS "v", NULL AS "vs", NULL AS "u" WHERE false) e
),
-- The batch's records, k being their concept: by its concept column, or by its source concept column when that names another one
  scope AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.concept_id AS k, e.patient_id, e.value_number, e.value_string, e.unit, e.start_datetime FROM linkr_event_measurements e WHERE e.concept_id IN (/*LINKR_IDS*/)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.source_concept_id AS k, e.patient_id, e.value_number, e.value_string, e.unit, e.start_datetime FROM linkr_event_measurements e WHERE e.source_concept_id IN (/*LINKR_IDS*/) AND e.concept_id IS DISTINCT FROM e.source_concept_id
),
  -- A concept's figures over all its records: counts, missing values, percentiles, unit
  base AS (SELECT e.k, COUNT(*) AS rows_count, COUNT(DISTINCT e.patient_id) AS patients_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN e.value_number IS NULL AND (e.value_string IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(e.value_string AS VARCHAR)) = '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS missing_rate, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.01) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.value_number) AS p1, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.value_number) AS p25, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.value_number) AS median, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.value_number) AS p75, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.value_number) AS p99, COUNT(e.value_number) FILTER (WHERE e.value_number IS NOT NULL) AS numeric_count, mode(CAST(e.unit AS VARCHAR)) FILTER (WHERE CAST(e.unit AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CAST(e.unit AS VARCHAR)) <> '') AS unit FROM scope e GROUP BY e.k),
  -- Records per patient: their mean, median, min and max
  per_patient AS (
    SELECT k, ROUND(AVG(n), 1) AS per_patient_mean, MEDIAN(n) AS per_patient_median, MIN(n) AS per_patient_min, MAX(n) AS per_patient_max
    FROM (SELECT e.k, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scope e GROUP BY e.k, e.patient_id) GROUP BY k),
  -- Hours between two records of a patient, in time order: their median
  frequency AS (
    SELECT k, MEDIAN(hours) AS median_hours FROM (
      SELECT k, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ts - LAG(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY k, patient_id ORDER BY ts))) / 3600.0 AS hours
      FROM (SELECT e.k, e.patient_id AS patient_id, CAST(e.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS ts FROM scope e WHERE e.start_datetime IS NOT NULL)
    ) WHERE hours > 0 GROUP BY k),
  -- A concept's figures on one row
  scalar AS (
    SELECT base.k, base.* EXCLUDE (k), per_patient.* EXCLUDE (k), frequency.* EXCLUDE (k)
    FROM base LEFT JOIN per_patient USING (k) LEFT JOIN frequency USING (k)),
  -- The concepts described further: the bounds past which a value is an outlier, the histogram's number of bins
  fences AS (SELECT k, CASE WHEN numeric_count > 0 AND p25 IS NOT NULL AND p75 IS NOT NULL AND TRUE AND isfinite(p25 - CAST('1.5' AS DOUBLE) * (p75 - p25)) AND isfinite(p75 + CAST('1.5' AS DOUBLE) * (p75 - p25)) THEN p25 - CAST('1.5' AS DOUBLE) * (p75 - p25) END AS lo, CASE WHEN numeric_count > 0 AND p25 IS NOT NULL AND p75 IS NOT NULL AND TRUE AND isfinite(p25 - CAST('1.5' AS DOUBLE) * (p75 - p25)) AND isfinite(p75 + CAST('1.5' AS DOUBLE) * (p75 - p25)) THEN p75 + CAST('1.5' AS DOUBLE) * (p75 - p25) END AS hi, CAST(LEAST(50, GREATEST(1, CEIL(1 + LOG2(GREATEST(1, numeric_count))))) AS INTEGER) AS bins FROM scalar WHERE TRUE),
  -- Their records
  kept AS (SELECT e.* FROM scope e WHERE e.k IN (SELECT k FROM fences)),
  -- The histogram: the values within the bounds…
  filtered AS (
    SELECT e.k, e.value_number AS value, e.patient_id AS patient_id
    FROM scope e JOIN fences f ON f.k = e.k WHERE e.value_number IS NOT NULL AND (f.lo IS NULL OR (e.value_number >= f.lo AND e.value_number <= f.hi))
  ),
  -- …the width of a bin over their range…
  spread AS (
    SELECT x.k, (MAX(x.value) - MIN(x.value)) / ANY_VALUE(f.bins) AS width FROM filtered x JOIN fences f ON f.k = x.k GROUP BY x.k
  ),
  -- …rounded up to 1, 2, 5 or 10 times a power of ten…
  magnitude AS (
    SELECT k, width / POW(10, FLOOR(LOG10(width))) AS mantissa, CAST(FLOOR(LOG10(width)) AS INTEGER) AS step_e
    FROM spread WHERE width > 0
  ),
  step AS (
    SELECT k, CASE WHEN mantissa <= 1 THEN 1 WHEN mantissa <= 2 THEN 2 WHEN mantissa <= 5 THEN 5 ELSE 10 END AS step_m, step_e
    FROM magnitude
  ),
  -- …and each value's bin, counted
  bins AS (
    SELECT x.k, CAST(FLOOR(CASE WHEN s.step_e < 0 THEN x.value * POW(10, -s.step_e) / s.step_m
                              ELSE x.value / (s.step_m * POW(10, s.step_e)) END) AS INTEGER) AS bin_idx,
           s.step_m, s.step_e, COUNT(*) AS count,
           COUNT(DISTINCT x.patient_id) AS patients_count
    FROM filtered x JOIN step s ON s.k = x.k GROUP BY ALL
  )
  -- Block 'scalar': a concept's figures
  (SELECT 'scalar' AS block, k, 0 AS ord, rows_count AS s_rows_count, patients_count AS s_patients_count, missing_rate AS s_missing_rate, p1 AS s_p1, p25 AS s_p25, median AS s_median, p75 AS s_p75, p99 AS s_p99, numeric_count AS s_numeric_count, unit AS s_unit, per_patient_mean AS s_per_patient_mean, per_patient_median AS s_per_patient_median, per_patient_min AS s_per_patient_min, per_patient_max AS s_per_patient_max, median_hours AS s_median_hours FROM scalar)
  UNION ALL BY NAME
  -- Block 'numeric': the values within the bounds — range, mean, median, spread, percentiles
  (SELECT 'numeric' AS block, e.k, 0 AS ord,
    MIN(e.value_number) AS min,
    MAX(e.value_number) AS max,
    ROUND(AVG(e.value_number), 1) AS mean,
    ROUND(MEDIAN(e.value_number), 1) AS median,
    ROUND(STDDEV(e.value_number), 1) AS sd,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.05) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.value_number), 1) AS p5,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.value_number), 1) AS p25,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.value_number), 1) AS p75,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.value_number), 1) AS p95,
    COUNT(e.value_number) AS numeric_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.patient_id) AS numeric_patients_count
  FROM scope e JOIN fences f ON f.k = e.k WHERE e.value_number IS NOT NULL AND (f.lo IS NULL OR (e.value_number >= f.lo AND e.value_number <= f.hi)) GROUP BY e.k)
  UNION ALL BY NAME
  -- Block 'histogram': a row per bin
  (SELECT 'histogram' AS block, k, bin_idx AS ord, bin_idx, step_m, step_e, count, patients_count FROM bins)
  UNION ALL BY NAME
  -- Block 'categorical': the most frequent text values
  (SELECT 'categorical' AS block, k, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY count DESC, category ASC) AS ord,
    category, count, patients_count, ROUND(count * 100.0 / SUM(count) OVER (PARTITION BY k), 1) AS percentage FROM (
    SELECT e.k, CAST(e.value_string AS VARCHAR) AS category, COUNT(*) AS count, COUNT(DISTINCT e.patient_id) AS patients_count
    FROM kept e WHERE CAST(e.value_string AS VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CAST(e.value_string AS VARCHAR)) <> ''
    GROUP BY e.k, CAST(e.value_string AS VARCHAR)
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1
  ) QUALIFY ord <= 200)
  UNION ALL BY NAME
  -- Block 'temporal': records per year, first and last dates
  (SELECT 'temporal' AS block, k, year AS ord, year, count, patients_count, percentage, start_date, end_date FROM (
    SELECT k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ts) AS year, COUNT(*) AS count,
         COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patients_count,
         ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY k), 1) AS percentage,
         MIN(MIN(ts)) OVER (PARTITION BY k)::DATE AS start_date,
         MAX(MAX(ts)) OVER (PARTITION BY k)::DATE AS end_date
    FROM (SELECT e.k, CAST(e.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS ts, e.patient_id AS patient_id
          FROM kept e WHERE e.start_datetime IS NOT NULL)
    GROUP BY k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ts)))
